blocks.text: Onboarding a GitHub tenant to AI Security Admin Portal connects your organization’s GitHub environment (enterprise, organizations, and repositories) to the AI Security Admin Portal. This connection enables AI Security to discover, assess, and help you govern AI-related activity and risks across your codebase and developer workflows. The system checks for new repositories twice daily, at 12:00 AM and 12:00 PM UTC.
The following agentic frameworks are supported: CrewAI, n8n, OpenAI Agents, Langchain, Pydantic AI, Google ADK, LlamaIndex, DeepAgents, Strands, Microsoft Agent Framework and Haystack.
To onboard a GitHub tenant, do the following:

blocks.item: Go to Administration > Account Onboarding.
Click + Add New.
The Start Onboarding window appears.
Select Code Repository.
See image.
In the Select Code Repository window, select the GitHub tile.
See image.
The Add GitHub Tenant window appears.
In the Integration Alias field, enter a user-friendly name to identify this integration.
Click Authorize with GitHub.
See image.
You are redirected to the GitHub account you are currently logged into.
Select the GitHub organizations you want to configure.
See image.
Install and authorize the Zscaler GitHub integration app.
You are prompted to install the integration app so that it can read metadata of GitHub and read files from your repository for scanning.
Choose the repository access scope from the following:
All repositories: All current and future repositories owned by the resource owner. This also includes public repositories.
Only select repositories: Select one or more repositories. This also includes public repositories.
See image.
Click Save.
Return to the Account Onboarding page to verify onboarding.
